caption: Input starts the chain; the script applies an impulse of 1.6 N·s to a 0.8 kg body, so the body moves at 2.0 m/s, and a collision event returns to the script before the display updates.

spec.aria: A sequence where input sends a button event to the script, the script calls AddForce on physics, physics returns a collision hit, and the script updates the display.
